content:
maya_p: quick ask — we need a one-sheet (fast facts) for enterprise prospects that covers SLAs, security controls, and deployment modes. Target: AE enablement + webinar handout. Can someone own and aETA?
liam_s: happy to own with ashley_marketing. can we get a draft by EOD Tue? what's the minimal must-have list?
ashley_marketing: must-haves: 1) SLA bullets (uptime promise, p99 latency targets by tier) 2) Security controls summary (VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2) 3) Deployment options (hosted API, dedicated/reserved, private/VPC) 4) Inbound lead routing + sales play 5) Benchmark highlights (cost/latency delta) 6) CTA + trial/contact steps :+1:
sam_grow: for benchmark narrative — use phrasing like: "In our perf lab (Mar 2026), typical cloud endpoints showed higher token cost and 20–35% higher p99 latency on 8k sequences; Redwood delivers comparable quality at lower unit cost and faster tail latencies." we'll add a small chart in the sheet. :memo:
maya_p: also need a simple inbound routing snippet for HubSpot -> AE routing. example for the doc — keep it non-technical but clear. quick sample below to include as an appendix: 
```
# pseudo-rule for lead routing
if lead.company_size >= 1000 and lead.sla_required == true:
    route_to = "enterprise_AE_queue"
else:
    route_to = "self_serve_flow"
```
liam_s: tiny edit — avoid naming competitors directly. use "major cloud endpoints" or "common endpoint providers" in the sheet. :thinking_face:
ashley_marketing: agreed. we'll say "major cloud endpoints" and footnote source: "internal perf lab, Mar 2026". i'll craft two headline variants for A/B testing in webinar CTAs. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: FYI — please include a compliance checkbox section: FedRAMP, ISO27001, and KMS integration notes for enterprise legal/sales.
maya_p: perfect. i'll draft the one-sheet skeleton this afternoon and share a Google doc. ashley_marketing — can you prepare the 2 headline variants + 2 body messaging options? liam_s — can you export HubSpot workflow JSON for the routing example and drop it here tomorrow? :white_check_mark:
ashley_marketing: on it. initial headline ideas: A) "Predictable LLM inference for enterprise SLAs" B) "Serve LLMs with enterprise-grade SLAs and security" — i'll test which converts better in the webinar registration form. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
liam_s: will do. recommendation for webinar: 30min presentation, 15min live Q&A, include a short live demo of failover/routing + quick perf slide. i'll add a note about routing in the webinar script. :thumbsup:
maya_p: thanks team — i'll post the draft doc link when ready and tag you for review.
